# fct_via_messages

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_via_messages` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for Via conversation messages. Each row is a single conversation message of any kind (user-prompt, text, tool-call, tool-return), not deduped, so costs can be tied to a specific message and summed across a conversation.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `message_id` | Primary Key. Unique ID for each Via conversation message. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | The advisor ID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The advisor UUID associated with the conversation. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_id` | Foreign Key. The Via conversation this message belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_id` | Foreign Key. The Via session this message belongs to. New sessions start after a 30+ minute gap in conversation activity. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_sequence` | The ordering of this message within all conversation messages. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `cost_usd` | The cost of this individual message in USD. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp when the message was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `latency_seconds` | The response latency for this message, in seconds. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `message_kind` | The kind of message ('user-prompt', 'text', 'tool-call', 'tool-return'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_name` | The name of the tool invoked, for 'tool-call'/'tool-return' messages only. Null otherwise. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `user_message_id` | Foreign Key. The user-prompt message this message was generated in response to. Null for user-prompt messages themselves. >> SOURCE - Portal |
